entries.title: Dream About an Ex Rejecting You
entries.meta_title: Ex Rejection Dream — Attachment Wound Replay | Oneirox
entries.meta_description: Ex-rejection dreams replay attachment wounds — pain rehearsal that can update or reinjure depending on waking work.
entries.lead: You reach. They turn away. Old rejection runs with fresh autonomic ink.
entries.signal: Attachment-pain memory is re-simulated — often when current vulnerability echoes the old wound’s shape.
body_paragraphs: Rejection replay is not always pathological; memory consolidation revisits emotional peaks. Intensity and frequency matter.
New dating anxiety commonly resurrects ex-rejection casts as warning templates.
If you reject them instead, role reversal may be rehearsing power reclaim.

variants.a: Wound plus audience — status and attachment fused.
Approach-avoid oscillation in one night.

entries.morning_prompt: What current vulnerability rhymes with that old no?

entries.title: Dream About Watching Your Ex from a Distance
entries.meta_title: Watching Ex Dream — Distanced Attachment Monitoring | Oneirox
entries.meta_description: Watching-an-ex dreams are distanced attachment monitoring — gaze without approach, often bittersweet.
entries.lead: You see them across a room, a street, a life. You do not approach — or cannot. Monitoring replaces reunion.
entries.signal: Attachment systems stay online in observer mode — approach inhibited while salience remains high.
body_paragraphs: Distance watching fits post-breakup phases where contact is limited but the file is not deleted.
Seeing them happy without you can be grief updating; seeing them suffer can be complicated relief/guilt.
Glass, windows, and crowds as barriers are inhibition metaphors.

variants.a: Salience asymmetric — you monitor, they do not bind.
Approach desire plus exposure fear.

entries.morning_prompt: Are you still allocating attention to a closed channel? Attention is the waking lever.

entries.title: Dream About a Parent Dying
entries.meta_title: Parent Dying Dream — Attachment Figure Loss Rehearsal | Oneirox
entries.meta_description: Parent-death dreams rehearse loss of a primary attachment figure — grief circuitry, not prediction by default.
entries.lead: A parent is dying or dead in the dream. The ground shifts. This is among the highest-cost attachment simulations the brain runs.
entries.signal: Primary attachment-loss rehearsal — often triggered by their illness, your aging awareness, or role reversal stress — not a reliable omen.
body_paragraphs: Even with healthy parents, adult children dream their deaths when dependency themes or mortality salience rise.
Caregiving load and hospital visits are strong continuity seeds; so is becoming a parent yourself.
If the dream is peaceful goodbye vs traumatic dying, affective processing goals differ — update vs threat.

variants.q: You cannot reach them in time
variants.a: Helpless caregiving — common when control over their health feels thin.
Grief reconsolidation — anniversaries and reminders reopen the file.

entries.morning_prompt: Call if you need contact; otherwise note what dependency fear woke with you.

entries.title: Dream About a Child Dying
entries.meta_title: Child Dying Dream — Caregiving Catastrophe Rehearsal | Oneirox
entries.meta_description: Child-death dreams are caregiving catastrophe rehearsals — extreme protective-system activation, not prophecy.
entries.lead: A child — yours or a stand-in — is in lethal danger or gone. Protective circuitry does not do mild.
entries.signal: Caregiving and protective systems are running a worst-case loss simulation — high amygdala, high urgency.
body_paragraphs: These dreams devastate dreamers and still are usually anxiety products, not forecasts. Frequency plus daytime impairment is when to seek support.
New parents and pregnancy periods elevate odds via protective hypervigilance.
Unknown children can stand for projects, inner-child material, or general vulnerability — still start with caregiving load.

variants.a: Protective efficacy fear — “am I enough?”
Rare; may mark dissociation or completed grief work — context matters.

entries.morning_prompt: Protective anxiety spiked by what real cue? Reduce cue load where possible.

entries.title: Dream About a Funeral
entries.meta_title: Funeral Dream — Social Grief Ritual Simulation | Oneirox
entries.meta_description: Funeral dreams stage social grief ritual — mourning with witnesses, not only private loss affect.
entries.lead: Casket, clothes, speeches. Loss becomes public procedure. The dream is processing grief as a social event.
entries.signal: Bereavement systems plus social ritual schemas are consolidating — how loss is performed in front of others.
body_paragraphs: Funerals in dreams appear after real deaths and also when a role/identity is ending and needs a rite.
Wrong funeral details (laughing guests, empty casket) mark prediction error in how mourning “should” go.
Being unprepared for the funeral stacks evaluation onto grief.

variants.a: Identity ending with audience — ego-death metaphor optional; role-death continuity common.
Anticipatory grief or symbolic role ending for that bond.

entries.morning_prompt: What ending needs acknowledgment you have not given it?

entries.title: Dream About Unexpected Pregnancy
entries.meta_title: Unexpected Pregnancy Dream — New Load Embodiment | Oneirox
entries.meta_description: Unexpected-pregnancy dreams embody new irreversible load — creative or life projects wearing gestation costume.
entries.lead: The test is positive. Shock. A body future arrives early. Gestation is an unmatched metaphor for irreversible growth of responsibility.
entries.signal: Future-load embodiment: something growing inside a life container that cannot be casually undone — project, role, or literal reproductive anxiety.
body_paragraphs: People of many genders report pregnancy dreams when starting companies, books, caregiving, or actual conception attempts.
Shock affect sorts unwanted load from desired; calm curiosity sorts differently.
Literal pregnancy possibility should be reality-checked waking when relevant — mechanism talk does not replace tests.

variants.a: Solo load growth — responsibility without co-agent.
External validation of the new load — evaluation enters embodiment.

entries.morning_prompt: What new responsibility is growing whether you feel ready or not?

entries.title: Dream About Giving Birth
entries.meta_title: Giving Birth Dream — Transition Through Peak Effort | Oneirox
entries.meta_description: Birth dreams stage peak-effort transition — delivery of a long-carried load into the world.
entries.lead: Labor. Push. Something arrives. Whether literal or metaphor, the scene is transition under maximum effort.
entries.signal: A carried project or identity is crossing from internal to external under high effort and vulnerability — delivery schema.
body_paragraphs: Creators dream birth near launches. Students near graduations. The body story maps emergence.
Complications in dream labor often track fear that the transition will injure you or the “baby” (work).
Relief after birth is completion affect; emptiness can mark identity lag after delivery.

variants.a: Transition with low threat dye — readiness signature for some.
Emergence under evaluation eyes.

entries.morning_prompt: What are you trying to deliver into the world this month?

entries.title: Dream About Feeling Pregnant When You Are Not
entries.meta_title: False Pregnancy Feeling Dream — Interoceptive Belly Bind | Oneirox
entries.meta_description: False pregnancy-feel dreams bind belly interoception to gestation narrative — gut/abdomen signals matter.
entries.lead: Your abdomen feels full, stretched, sure. Waking, it is not pregnancy. Interoception wrote a gestation plot.
entries.signal: Abdominal interoceptive noise is being explained with a pregnancy schema — bloating, tension, or hormonal nights as seeds.
body_paragraphs: Start with the belly: digestion, menstrual cycle, anxiety gut, tight sleepwear. The cortex needs a story for pressure.
Psychological pregnancy themes can stack on top of the body seed — both/and.
If cycles and fertility stress are active, continuity is dual: body plus hope/fear.

variants.a: Visual confirm of interoceptive story.

variants.q: Relief when not pregnant on waking
variants.a: Threat dye was high on the gestation schema.

entries.morning_prompt: Any real abdominal sensation overnight? Log it beside the plot.

entries.title: Dream About Clocks Showing 11:11
entries.meta_title: 11:11 Clock Dream — Salient Time Pattern Bind | Oneirox
entries.meta_description: 11:11 dream clocks are salient time-pattern binds — attention sticky digits, not destiny codes by default.
entries.lead: Every clock reads 11:11. Awe or unease. Pattern-hungry cortex met a culturally primed digit string.
entries.signal: Temporal attention is binding to a high-salience repeated digit pattern — often primed by waking noticing habits.
body_paragraphs: Humans are pattern detectors. Repeating digits feel meaningful because rarity + symmetry grab attention — in wake and in REM.
If you check 11:11 waking, continuity will import it. That is priming, not cosmos.
Anxiety versions treat the pattern as countdown; calm versions treat it as odd coincidence theater.

variants.a: Pattern forced across instruments — high binding drive.
Anticipation loop — intentional pattern seeking inside the dream.

entries.morning_prompt: Did you reinforce digit noticing yesterday? Priming is the lever.

entries.title: Dream About Repeating Threes Everywhere
entries.meta_title: Repeating Threes Dream — Triadic Pattern Capture | Oneirox
entries.meta_description: Repeating-three dreams show triadic pattern capture — cortex locking a small integer across scenes.
entries.lead: Three doors. Three calls. Triplets on signs. A small integer becomes the night’s organizing rule.
entries.signal: Working-memory-friendly chunking (three) is over-applied as a scene grammar — pattern capture during consolidation.
body_paragraphs: Three is cognitively sticky (lists, acts, tries). Dreams can elevate it into a law of the world for a night.
OCD-leaning pattern nights and counting habits bias this; so does learning that uses triads.
Fear arrives when the pattern feels compulsory; playfulness when it feels like a puzzle.

variants.q: You must do things in threes
variants.a: Compulsion grammar — rule-following under anxiety.
Narrative using triad structure for delayed success.

entries.morning_prompt: Any counting or rule rituals loud lately? Note compulsion load.

entries.title: Dream About a Countdown
entries.meta_title: Countdown Dream — Explicit Temporal Threat | Oneirox
entries.meta_description: Countdown dreams make time-threat explicit — numbers decreasing toward a consequence.
entries.lead: 10, 9, 8… Something will happen at zero. Time is no longer background; it is the antagonist.
entries.signal: Temporal threat is rendered as an explicit decrementing counter — deadline anxiety with a visible fuse.
body_paragraphs: Countdowns appear in bomb, launch, exam, and labor dreams. The shared hardware is approaching zero.
Unlike frozen clocks, countdowns still “work” — too well. Prediction is clear; agency may not be.
Stopping the countdown is inhibitory triumph; watching it hit zero is consequence acceptance or freeze.

variants.a: Technological fuse — modern deadline avatar.
Auditory temporal threat — social or system voice.

entries.morning_prompt: What real fuse is lit? Shorten or extinguish it waking.

entries.title: Recurring Dream of the Same Place
entries.meta_title: Same Place Recurring Dream — Spatial Rehearsal Loop | Oneirox
entries.meta_description: Same-place recurring dreams are spatial rehearsal loops — a saved map reloads until updated.
entries.lead: Back in that hallway, campus, house wing. Plot may shift; place stays. The location is the stuck file.
entries.signal: A high-density place memory is being re-entered across nights — unfinished spatial-affect business.
body_paragraphs: Recurring places are excellent targets for imagery rehearsal: change one detail waking before sleep.
School campuses and old homes dominate because of map density, not mysticism.
If affect softens across months, updating is working even when place repeats.

variants.a: Stable stage, new scenes — partial flexibility.
Meta-awareness entering the loop — leverage for rewrite.

entries.morning_prompt: What unfinished feeling lives in that place? Rewrite one ending tonight on purpose.

entries.title: Recurring Dream Where You Gradually Improve
entries.meta_title: Improving Recurring Dream — Offline Skill Rehearsal | Oneirox
entries.meta_description: Progressing recurring dreams look like offline skill rehearsal — the loop updates toward competence.
entries.lead: Same challenge, better performance each week. Flying farther. Escaping sooner. The rehearsal is working.
entries.signal: Procedural or coping rehearsal across nights with measurable dream-performance gain — consolidation with a learning curve.
body_paragraphs: Not all recurrence is stuck pathology. Some loops are practice. Athletes and musicians know overnight gains; dream coping can rhyme.
Track the metric that improves — distance, calm, success rate — as evidence of updating.
If improvement stalls, daytime practice or therapy technique may be needed to feed new material.

variants.q: You notice the improvement inside the dream
variants.a: Meta-learning online — strong update signature.

variants.q: Skill improves but place stays scary
variants.a: Competence up, affect map lagging.

entries.morning_prompt: What waking skill is this loop practicing? Feed it deliberate practice by day.

entries.title: Recurring Nightmare Loop
entries.meta_title: Recurring Nightmare Loop — Stuck Threat Rehearsal | Oneirox
entries.meta_description: Recurring nightmare loops are stuck threat rehearsals — same fear geometry until safety learning updates.
entries.lead: Same terror grammar. Different props maybe. You wake braced. This is the pathological end of recurrence — treatable.
entries.signal: Threat-simulation is replaying without successful extinction — high amygdala, incomplete safety learning.
body_paragraphs: Imagery rehearsal therapy, sleep regularization, and treating daytime PTSD/anxiety load are evidence-linked paths — not symbol dictionaries.
Alcohol rebound and fragmented REM worsen loops.
If nightmares cause fear of sleep, seek clinical care; frequency and impairment matter.

variants.a: Highly consolidated threat script — strong candidate for structured rewrite therapy.
State-gated recurrence — map and reduce triggers.

entries.morning_prompt: Rate impairment 1–10. Above mild for weeks → professional support, not more interpretation.

entries.title: Dream That Leaves Morning Anxiety
entries.meta_title: Morning Anxiety After Dream — Affect Spillover | Oneirox
entries.meta_description: Morning anxiety residue is affective spillover from late-REM — body alarm outlasting plot memory.
entries.lead: You forget the dream. The dread stays in the chest. Spillover is the mechanism worth tracking.
entries.signal: Late-cycle limbic activation spills into wake before prefrontal regulation fully comes online — anxiety without a remembered script.
body_paragraphs: Cortisol awakening response can amplify dream residue. Separating “body anxiety” from “story anxiety” helps response choice.
Journaling plot is optional; downregulating physiology is often the higher-yield morning move.
Chronic morning dread with sparse recall still deserves anxiety care if impairing.

variants.a: Typical spillover decay — note and hydrate/move.
Higher load — treat as daytime anxiety signal, not only dream.

entries.morning_prompt: Body first: breath, light, brief walk — then decide if plot matters.

entries.title: Dream About a Social Anxiety Scene
entries.meta_title: Social Anxiety Dream — Evaluation Scene Rehearsal | Oneirox
entries.meta_description: Social-anxiety dreams rehearse evaluation scenes — parties, introductions, wrong words under eyes.
entries.lead: A party. A greeting gone wrong. Faces wait. Social anxiety does not need a monster; it needs an audience.
entries.signal: Social-evaluation threat is staged as interpersonal performance failure — continuity with waking social fear.
body_paragraphs: Blushing, blanking, saying the wrong thing, and being ignored are common props. They are competence/belonging threats in social costume.
Upcoming events prime these heavily the nights before.
Successful social moments in the same dream mark coping rehearsal beginning to update.

variants.q: You cannot find anyone you know
variants.a: Belonging fail — affiliation threat without evaluation speech.

variants.q: Everyone speaks a language you lack
variants.a: Channel mismatch — cannot join the in-group code.

entries.morning_prompt: What real social event is loaded? One exposure step beats symbol work.

entries.title: Vivid Snake Dream at Awakening
entries.meta_title: Vivid Snake at Awakening — REM Salience Spill | Oneirox
entries.meta_description: A vivid snake at awakening is high-salience REM imagery spilling into wake — visual intensity, not a color dictionary.
entries.lead: The snake is hyper-real as you wake — color, scale, presence extreme. That intensity is REM visual/affective salience, not an omen chart about hue.
entries.signal: Phasic REM imagery with high visual salience overlaps the wake edge — hypnopompic continuation of a predator schema.
body_paragraphs: Vividness tracks arousal and sensory gating at transitions, not moral meanings of green/black/white. Oneirox refuses color-as-symbol doorways; intensity is the variable.
Hypnopompic carryover can make the snake feel briefly “still in the room.” That is edge-state perception, then it collapses.
If vivid animal imagery at wake is frequent with paralysis or fear, read sleep-paralysis pages in parallel.

variants.a: Hypnopompic visual persistence — seconds, then sensory gates win.
Salience marker — treat as intensity, not color lexicon.

entries.morning_prompt: Intensity 1–10 and any paralysis? Log those; skip color omen lists.

entries.title: Vivid Dog Dream at Awakening
entries.meta_title: Vivid Dog at Awakening — Social Animal Salience Spill | Oneirox
entries.meta_description: A vivid dog at wake is social-animal REM salience spilling into hypnopompic edge — intensity, not coat-color omen.
entries.lead: The dog is too real as morning arrives — bark, fur detail, eyes. Salience spill with an affiliation-capable animal.
entries.signal: High-salience canid imagery crossing the wake gate — hypnopompic persistence of a social-threat or social-bond schema.
body_paragraphs: Same rule as vivid snakes: intensity ≠ dictionary. Coat color is not destiny; arousal amplitude is the lab variable.
Friendly vivid dogs at wake can be affiliation salience; aggressive ones are threat salience — affect sorts them.
Real pets in the room can fuse with dream imagery at the edge — check literal animal presence.

variants.q: Dog standing over the bed at wake
variants.a: Proximity + hypnopompic bind — rule out real pet first.
Partial visual persistence as REM imagery collapses.

entries.morning_prompt: Friendly or threatening affect? That binary matters more than breed or color.
